build_retina_sepbn_head: build a RetinaSepBNHead instance with separate BN layers for object detection across FPN levels
init_retina_sepbn_head_layers: initialize the classification and regression conv layers of a RetinaSepBNHead for multi-scale detection
init_retina_sepbn_head_weights: initialize the weights of a RetinaSepBNHead using normal distribution and bias probability
run_retina_sepbn_head_forward: run the forward pass of RetinaSepBNHead on feature tensors to get cls scores and bbox predictions
review_retina_sepbn_head: review the RetinaSepBNHead class to understand how conv layers are shared but BN layers are separated
